"""Iterative binary search implementation with test cases."""

def binary_search(arr, target):
    """Return the index of target in sorted list arr, or -1 if not found.
    
    Uses an iterative approach with O(log n) time complexity.
    """
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1          # search boundaries
    while left <= right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2         # middle index
        if arr[mid] == target:
            return mid                    # target found
        elif arr[mid] < target:
            left = mid + 1                # search right half
        else:
            right = mid - 1               # search left half
    return -1                             # not found
